استتفها (form X)
# اِسْتَتْفَهَا (istatfahā) /is.tat.fa.haː/: third-person masculine dual past active of اِسْتَتْفَهَ (istatfaha)
# اُسْتُتْفِهَا (ustutfihā) /us.tut.fi.haː/: third-person masculine dual past passive of اِسْتَتْفَهَ (istatfaha)
# اِسْتَتْفِهَا (istatfihā) /is.tat.fi.haː/: second-person dual imperative of اِسْتَتْفَهَ (istatfaha)
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
